target_customer: US consumers with chronic conditions (gut and sleep disorders, diabetes, arthritis, postpartum thyroiditis) who want natural care plans
problem: People with chronic conditions find conventional medicine weak on root causes and look for personalized natural care. Saatvy paired them with Ayurveda practitioners who wrote personalized health plans.
business_model: Paid consultations and personalized Ayurveda care plans sold to consumers

founders.name: Ankur Rustagi
previous_startups: Sero AI (trust and safety software, YC)
founders.background_notes: YC page describes him as an engineering and people leader with over a decade of machine learning experience.

founders.name: Talha Baig
founders.background_notes: YC page lists both as former founders. A podcast description mentions a co-founder departure, without details.

exit.reason: Not public. YC lists the company as Inactive with its founders under Former Founders.

competitors.name: Lifechart
competitors.what: Indian startup connecting patients to Ayurveda doctors digitally by phone and chat

technical_complexity.rationale: A consultation and care plan workflow between customers and practitioners. No hard engineering is described, and the AI tag is not backed by a described product.

defensibility.rationale: Anyone could contract Ayurveda practitioners and sell plans. The only edge claimed was practitioner credentials, which are not exclusive.

takeover_risk_then.outcome: No incumbent responded. The company appears to have stopped and the founders list it as a former venture.

market_need_then: Demand for alternative and natural wellness care for chronic conditions existed, and the company says several people in the USA used it. No spend or traction figures were found.

branding.domain_note: Used saatvy.com, which now shows only a short greeting page.

identity.visual_style: A freelance designer published a case study for an Ayurvedic wellness site named Saatvy, mentioning typography and spacing
identity.voice_and_tone: Plain wellness language about root causes and natural care

brand_strength.rationale: No press or community coverage of the brand was found. The name resembles the Sanskrit sattva and the US mattress brand Saatva, which makes it easy to confuse.

pivots.from: Sero AI, trust and safety workflow software (YC)
pivots.why: A podcast episode description says Rustagi moved from Sero AI to Saatvy after about ten months. The reason was not found.

outcome_analysis: Saatvy was a one person Ayurveda wellness venture that grew out of a pivot from the founders' earlier trust and safety company Sero AI. No funding, traction figures or shutdown explanation were published. YC marks it inactive and the website is a stub. The cause of failure is not public, so the pivot_failed code reflects only that the move away from Sero AI did not lead to a lasting company.
notes: Searches for shutdown news only returned a different company, The Ayurveda Co. A BounceWatch page labels Saatvy Health as pre-seed but conflates it with Sero AI and gives no amount or date, so no round is recorded. Altss labels the company Inactive. saatvy.com showed only a greeting when fetched.
